title: Get / got / got
descriptionFa: get برای تغییر حالت (شدن)، get به معنی گرفتن و خریدن، و get برای رسیدن.

words.example: I got a new phone for my birthday.
I'm going to the shop to get some bread.
words.tipFa: get a taxi, get a doctor, get a stamp: یعنی بگیر، بخر یا بیار.

words.example: It's getting dark. Let's go home.
words.tipFa: get + صفت = شدن: get tired, get wet, get cold.

words.example: I hope you get better soon!
words.tipFa: She's getting better = داره بهتر می‌شه.

words.example: I always get tired after a long day at school.
Take an umbrella or you'll get wet.
After university, I want to get a job in a bank.
Call me when you get to Tehran.
words.tipFa: How can I get to the airport? = چطور برم فرودگاه؟

words.example: I'll call you when I get back from Kish.
When I get home, I always have a cup of tea.
words.tipFa: بدون to: get home و get there، نه get to home.
